mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id, oi.product_name, p.thumbnail_url, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at FROM REVIEW r JOIN ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE r.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.review_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
